description: Divides a linear sector index by 11 to split it into a track number and an in-track sector, reading a different global flag to choose the step size.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:087E
name: convert_sector_to_track_position
description: Divides a linear sector index by 11 to split it into a track number and an in-track sector, then runs a sequence of helper calls to finish the position.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:08A2
name: convert_sector_count_to_track
description: Takes a sector count and returns early when it is zero, otherwise divides the starting sector by 11 and walks forward through the track positions until the count is used up.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0984
name: retry_disk_track_sync_scan
description: Retries a disk track up to four times, clearing per-sector counters and reading the CIA-A port for disk status. When the write path is active it stores the alternating-bit gap and the MFM sync word into the track buffer.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0A54
name: verify_track_sector_match
description: Repeats up to ten read attempts, returning error 24 if all fail and 27 when the sector number does not match, otherwise it stores a derived slot value and returns zero.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0AAC
name: verify_sector_slots_in_track
description: Walks up to eleven sector slots, testing a status bit and a bitmask of already-seen sectors, and returns zero on success or error 24, 25, 27 or minus one when a slot is missing, mismatched or the status bit signals failure.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0B6C
name: return_without_action
description: A five-instruction routine that performs no work and simply returns, with no memory, register or call references.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0B7C
name: set_bit_and_increment_counter
description: Sets one bit in a 16-bit word located a few bytes before the A6 pointer, with the bit index taken from D3, then increments a 16-bit counter stored just before the same pointer.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0B8C
name: clear_strided_longword_column
description: Writes zero to ten 32-bit words spaced 1088 bytes apart, starting at the pointer in A5, to clear one column of a table.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0B9E
name: pack_low_word_top_byte
description: Calls a routine to obtain a 32-bit value, then returns its low 16 bits in the high half and its top byte in the low half of the result.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0BBE
name: interleave_longword_bits
description: Takes two consecutive 32-bit values from the pointer in A0, keeps the alternate bits of the second and places the alternate bits of the first, shifted left by one, into the gaps.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0BD4
name: apply_interleave_xor_mask
description: Obtains an interleaved 32-bit value from one routine and passes it to a second routine that performs the XOR and alternate-bit mask step.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0BE2
name: xor_fold_ten_longwords
description: XORs ten consecutive 32-bit words starting eight bytes past the pointer in A5 and returns the result masked to alternate bits.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0BE8
name: xor_fold_longword_block
description: XORs a block of 32-bit words from the pointer in A0 whose count is derived from the upper bits of D1, then returns the result masked to alternate bits.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0C02
name: interleave_two_longword_blocks
description: Walks 128 pairs of 32-bit words, writing to the output buffer at A1 a value that combines alternate bits from the first block, doubled, with alternate bits from the second block.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0C2A
name: start_disk_dma_transfer
description: Programs the disk controller for a DMA transfer: it writes the control registers, loads the MFM sync word, sets the buffer pointer and sets the transfer length from the word in D0.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0C68
name: test_status_bit_or_fail
description: Tests bit one of a status byte at a fixed offset from a pointer and returns zero when it is set; otherwise it runs one helper step and returns minus one.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0CA0
name: set_disk_control_if_flagged
description: Writes a fixed value to the disk control register, then, if a stored flag is negative, writes a single-bit mask computed from a stored index to the same register.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0CB0
name: set_ciab_port_bit
description: Computes a bit index from a stored 16-bit value plus three and writes the CIA-B port register with that bit set.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0CCE
name: wait_for_ciab_port_flag
description: Writes an all-ones value to a register, then repeatedly calls a helper and waits while bit zero of the port stays set, returning zero when the loop ends.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0CE6
name: step_table_entry_toward_target
description: Reads a word from a table entry and, if its upper bits differ from the target, calls a helper once per step of the difference before storing the target back; it returns the stored value when the entry is negative.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0D34
name: wait_for_disk_status_clear
description: Polls a disk status bit of the CIA-A port for a fixed number of tries; if it clears it zeroes the table entry and returns zero, otherwise it returns error 30.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0D68
name: set_ciab_drive_control_wait
description: Clears or sets bits of the CIA-B port value depending on a sign flag, writes it back with bit zero set, then waits in a loop until bit zero clears.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0D8C
name: write_ciab_port_from_helper
description: Obtains a value from a helper routine and writes it to the CIA-B port register.

key: Project-X (1992)(Team 17)[cr SKR](Disk 1 of 4)[a2].adf boot-block load +$6E600 to $001000 (4096 bytes):0:0D96
name: compute_ciab_entry_mask
description: Computes a CIA-B port value by masking the current port byte with a bit index derived from a table entry, clearing one bit when that stored word has bit zero set, and returns it.
